semiconductor_relevance: High — Phenitec Semiconductor is a pioneering foundry manufacturer in Japan, specializing in front-end wafer foundry services and producing a range of semiconductor devices.
summary: Phenitec Semiconductor is a leading foundry service provider in Japan, offering semiconductor front-end wafer foundry services with a focus on automotive applications. With approximately 50 years of experience, the company manufactures a variety of devices, including SiC MOSFETs, and provides custom wafer supply and processing services.

regional_presence.Japan: Phenitec has manufacturing facilities in Ibara City, Okayama Prefecture, and Yusui Town, Kagoshima Prefecture, focusing on semiconductor production.
